name: Isolated 24-hour debug noise and judgment replay
target: Replay one fixed 24-hour input through production debug.log with Log Diet off and on, each into an isolated logs.db.
inputs: 720 repeated tox.loop/tick events and five protected decision events per hour
Temporary logs.db stores and a deterministic LogDietGuard clock
observations: Top-30 category/event counts and payload bytes from each isolated logs.db
Live database plus WAL bytes before checkpoint
Admission, observe, self-heal, HITL, and failure row counts remain equal
